My recommendation:

Casual or competitive gaming: Get a gaming headset.

Gaming + Discord: A headset is usually enough.

Streaming, YouTube, or content creation: Get a standalone USB mic.

Already have good headphones: Buy a standalone mic instead of replacing them.
